The '''Arabogradsk-Hamed Caliphate''' is a Khalari state associated with the central desert regions of the continent.

== Geography ==

The extracted Khalari source identifies Arabogradsk-Hamed as a country connected to Volgastan and as a major holder of the central Khalari desert regions. The 2003 and 2022 reference maps show it in the central Khalari political field near Volgastan and other regional powers.

== Nineteenth-Century Role ==

The Caliphate appears in the [[Svetian War]] source as one of the powers aligned against the Northern Alliance-backed coalition. The source says Volgastani-Arabogradsk forces were defeated during the war, including at the [[Battle of Kaplan Ridge]] in 1882.

== Source Limits ==

This draft does not settle the Caliphate's founding date, dynastic structure, or later twentieth-century government. It preserves only the source-supported role needed for the Khalari and Volgastan bridge.
